Contact us

We're here Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm UK time.

Emailcontact@mercieruk.co.uk
Post

Mercier, J & S House, Denton Drive, Northwich, CW9 7LU

Delivery

ServiceTimeCost
UK standard (Royal Mail Tracked or DPD)2 to 4 working days£4.99, free over £79.99
UK next working day (DPD)Order by 2pm Mon to Thu£6.99
Belgium, France, Germany, Ireland, Netherlands, Spain3 to 5 days£5.99
Rest of Europe5 to 8 days£8.99
USA5 to 8 days£9.99
Australia4 to 7 days£9.99
Canada, New Zealand5 to 7 days£14.99
Rest of world7 to 14 days£19.99

We cover customs duties up to €150. Next day isn't available during Black Friday week. Let us know within 10 days of the expected delivery date about missing or damaged parcels. We don't recommend asking for parcels to be left with a neighbour or in a safe place.

Returns

  • UK: 14 days from receiving your parcel. International: 21 days.
  • Items must be unworn, unwashed, with tags on and in the original packaging.
  • Return postage is paid by you, unless we made a mistake. Send it tracked and signed for.
  • Sale items and orders using a discount code are refunded as store credit.
  • 1/1 sample sale items, underwear and socks can't be returned.
  • We process returns within 7 working days.
Return address

FAQs

Where's my order?

You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships. Signed in? Track it from your account.

Can I pay later?

Yes. Split your order into 4 interest-free payments with Clearpay or Klarna at checkout.

Do you do student discount?

Yes, [15]% off with Student Beans. Verify at checkout.

How do Mercier Points work?

You earn 1 point per £1 spent and can swap points for money off. See how it works.

Can I change or cancel my order?

Email contact@mercieruk.co.uk as soon as possible with your order number. Once it's dispatched we can't change it.

Do you ship worldwide?

Yes, to almost every country. See for times and prices.

Est. October 2017

Mercier World

The name

Mercier launched in October 2017. The name comes from founder Ben Mercer's surname, Mercer, which traces back to the French Mercier: a dealer in textiles and fabrics.

We take that French inspiration into everything we design. We want to feel confident in the clothing we make, and we want you to feel the same way when you wear it.
